Name of NHRI - National Human Rights Commission of India (Preliminary status for 2026.)
series.indicator_description: Existence of independent national human rights institutions in compliance with the Paris Principles
series.target_description: Strengthen relevant national institutions, including through international cooperation, for building capacity at all levels, in particular in developing countries, to prevent violence and combat terrorism and crime

series.desc: Proportion of population reporting having felt discriminated against, by grounds of discrimination, sex and disability (%)
footnotes: Estimate refers to adults aged 18 years and over and is based on reported experiences of discrimination in the previous 12 months on the grounds of gender, religion or caste. The survey does not cover all grounds included in the standard SDG indicator methodology. Data were not produced nor validated by the NSO.
series.indicator_description: Proportion of population reporting having personally felt discriminated against or harassed in the previous 12 months on the basis of a ground of discrimination prohibited under international human rights law
series.target_description: Ensure equal opportunity and reduce inequalities of outcome, including by eliminating discriminatory laws, policies and practices and promoting appropriate legislation, policies and action in this regard
